about: Every Google Drive source that Adit Expert's internal knowledge (content/guides/*.html, the seeded team rules in lib/expert.js) was built from. The weekly check compares each file's Drive modifiedTime with imported_at and re-imports what changed. Folders are checked for new or changed files. Help Center articles, Desk and CRM data, product updates and team rules or notes are read live by the tool and need no re-import.
